title: Smoky Turkish Shrimp Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic vegetarian pilaf dish with smoky notes, reminiscent of Turkish cuisine. Perfect as a side or main course.

ingredients.name: Shrimp
ingredients.notes: Imagined for a vegetarian version, replace with portobello mushrooms or eggplant

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the Turkish pilaf and stir to coat with oil.
Add the smoky paprika and stir for 1-2 minutes.
Add the zesty lemon juice and stir to combine.
Add the shrimp (or portobello mushrooms or eggplant) and stir to combine.
Cook for 5-7 minutes or until the shrimp is pink and the pilaf is heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: Garnish with additional parsley and lemon wedges.
